author: 2BJ
body:
Minecraft IGN: MileyCyrus

Reason: "Excessive" Caps Lock

I'm aware of the fact that this infraction was nothing but a kick, but I'd still like to appeal it. All I said was, "oh my goD I STILL CAN'T SEE OUT OF MY RIGHT EYE." 3 minutes later, I was kicked.

*In other recent cases of spamming/caps/flooding the chat, players received a warning, then, was kicked if they continued:

- http://imgur.com/DhLWEAO

- http://imgur.com/1pQASCF

- http://imgur.com/RjCihCq

I was kicked without any type of warning, which I think was unfair.
